lines.zh: 我踩着滚烫的沙往前走。
lines.en: I walk the scorching sand.
My horns are heavy in the wind.
Step by step, steady.
I lead a few of us over the dune.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子陷进沙里，又拔出。
lines.en: My hooves sink into sand, then lift.
In the desert, we walk in herds.
I follow an old trail.
My shadow lies short on the sand.

lines.zh: 我带队绕过一片仙人掌。
lines.en: I lead the herd around a patch of cactus.
My coat is close to the sand's color.
I climb a slope slowly.
I stop and look back to wait.
My hooves land precisely.
I make my way along the dried channel.
My horn tips brush the brushwood.
I walk into the wind, eyes narrowed.
My gait never falters.

lines.zh: 我踩过的沙很快就被风吹平。
lines.en: The wind soon smooths the sand I tread.
I walk into a rock's shadow.

lines.zh: 我和队伍保持一个距离。
lines.en: I keep a distance from the herd.

lines.zh: 我站在沙丘顶上，看着远。
lines.en: I stand on the dune and look far.
Wind cools my horns.
I chew a bit of dry grass.

lines.zh: 耳朵一直转，沙里的声音太多。
lines.en: Ears keep turning, too many sounds in the sand.
The young ones stand by me.
I let my head sink slowly.

lines.zh: 我站在沙丘顶上，看得很远。
lines.en: On the dune crest, I see far.
This desert is quiet.
I'm reading the wind's direction.
My coat is full of sand.
I stand, and simply don't move.
My horns grow hot in the sun.
I wait for the herd to finish drinking.
I roll my neck slowly.
My shadow gathers at my feet.
I count the ridges of the dunes.

lines.zh: 我的角长到能碰到你的胸口。
lines.en: My horns grow long enough to reach your chest.
I turn my head slowly your way.
No bow in your hands. All right.

lines.zh: 我的角不是用来吓人的。
lines.en: My horns aren't for show.
Look me in the eye; I won't flinch.

lines.zh: 这一片沙地我走过很多次。
lines.en: I've crossed this sand many times.
In the desert we move as a herd.
I raise my eyes, then drop them.
Don't stand among us.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道从沙脊那边送来。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent over the dune crest.

lines.zh: 我一边嚼草，一边斜眼看你。
lines.en: I chew grass and eye you sideways.
I dislike being approached suddenly.

lines.zh: 队伍里的小的往我身后躲。
lines.en: The young in the herd hide behind me.
A bloody gash on my leg.
I fall back into the herd.
I rumble deep in my throat.
That struck my shoulder.
My horns dip and drag in the sand.
My legs still answer me.
The herd has backed away.
You're stronger than I assumed.
I need to move away a while.
I see that bit of green.
You've raised the grass.

lines.zh: 那点绿色在沙里太显眼。
lines.en: That patch of green is too obvious in the sand.
It's water I need more.

lines.zh: 沙漠里我们成排走，角朝前。
lines.en: In the desert we walk in a line, horns forward.
I put my nose to the grass.
The herd watches from behind.
Stay still and I'll come.
I lower my head and eat slowly.
My horns can be ground into a sword.
One more step forward.
That bit of green — I smelled it.

lines.zh: 我角很沉，踩着烫沙凑近你。
lines.en: Horns heavy, I cross the hot sand to you.
This smell reminds me of the river.
No hurry. I'll sniff first.
Step back and I'll relax.
You hit me and step back twice.
I turn aside to give room.

lines.zh: 我的长角在你肩上刮出一道沙痕。
lines.en: My long horn scrapes a line of sand across your shoulder.
Don't push; my hooves are dug in.
We collide and sand flies.
You step by my hoof.

lines.zh: 沙太软，我撞上你才刹住。
lines.en: The sand is too soft; I brake only after hitting you.
That shoved you off.
I'm against you. Warm.
I back into the herd.
I raise a forehoof and don't bring it down.
You steady yourself on my shoulder.
Another comes over, horns straight.
Our horns touch.
Its coat is paler than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，沙漠的角对着角。
lines.en: We stand side by side, horn to horn in the desert.
It lays its head against my neck.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向。
lines.en: We face the same direction.
The young ones trail behind us.

lines.zh: 我们走在一起，步子合上。
lines.en: We walk in step.
In the blowing sand we stay close.
This herd will grow.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子把草拨到沙上。
lines.en: I scrape the grass onto the sand with a hoof.
I paw the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的长角，我压在蹄下。
lines.en: With these desert horns, I pin it under a hoof.
This won't chew. I spit it out.
I sniff, and there's nothing.
It rolled in the sand; I paw it out.

lines.zh: 干草卷进嘴里，我一点一点咽。
lines.en: I roll dry grass into my mouth and swallow bit by bit.
I'm taking it. Don't follow.
I carry it to the young one.
I'll hold on to these.
You've grabbed one of the young.
I lower my long horns at you.
My horns are aimed at you.
The young are shielded behind my horns.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔喷出两道白气。
lines.en: Two plumes of breath shoot from my nostrils.
I step slowly to the front.
There's nowhere to hide in this sand.
My hoof scrapes the ground.
I don't like being crowded.

lines.zh: 我把角压低，蹄子扎进沙。
lines.en: I lower my horns and dig my hooves into the sand.
I follow at an easy pace.
I have your movements clear.
My shadow draws nearer.
I know this ground better than you.
I wait for you to look away.
My hooves have found their footing.
The dunes will slow you.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙脊走，影子在你上方。
lines.en: I move along the dune crest, my shadow above you.
Don't run; you won't get far.
Two more steps and I am close.

lines.zh: 我的角从下往上挑起沙。
lines.en: My horns scoop up sand from below.
A horn tip catches your armor.
That pushed you back.
My forehoof stamps the ground.
You twist aside and dodge.

lines.zh: 我斜着冲，角对准你的腰。
lines.en: I charge at an angle, horns aimed at your waist.
This desert horn makes a sword.

lines.zh: 我顶完就退，护着身后的小的。
lines.en: I back off after the hit, guarding the young behind me.
I flick my horns upward.
Sand clings to my horns.
A herd comes over the dune.

lines.zh: 沙脊上先出现我的一对长角。
lines.en: My pair of long horns crests the dune first.
My horns appear first.

lines.zh: 这片沙地多了几道蹄印。
lines.en: New hoofprints join this sand.
We spread out slowly.
I stand on the highest ridge.
Wind drifts sand to my hooves.
A desert oryx whose horns make a sword.

lines.zh: 这里的草够我们吃一阵。
lines.en: Enough grass here for a while.
My feet make no sound landing.
Fire scorches the fur on my leg.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘滚下去，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I roll down the dune, dazed.
Water's at my chest and I can't fight it.

lines.zh: 爆炸过后，我跪在沙里起身。
lines.en: After the blast, I push myself up from the sand.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的肩肉。
lines.en: An arrow bites into my shoulder.
The spell buckles my knees.

lines.zh: 这片沙里没什么可吃的。
lines.en: There's little to eat in this sand.

lines.zh: 角尖还冒着白烟，我甩头。
lines.en: Smoke still rises from my horn tips; I shake my head.
The sand drains away and my feet find nothing.
